text_to_image_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE original landscape scene asset, 1536x1024, full-bleed independent image for an interactive story environment library. Composition must provide an uncluttered foreground and layered environmental depth. Entire scene is unoccupied: absolutely no people, characters, silhouettes, human reflections, portraits, statues, mannequins, humanoid robots, animals, birds, fish or insects. Plants and flowers allowed. No text, labels, logos, signatures, watermarks, borders or collage. Follow the specified medium faithfully, with an attractive coherent palette and legible architecture. Transparent watercolor floating island post office among spring clouds, small tiled-roof postal pavilion with blank sign, empty parcel counter and winding stone path, bridges disappearing into sky, peach-pink and pale blue washes with fresh green, delicate ink accents, beautiful handmade paper granulation.
